author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark. Three candidates, none meaning-preserving: (1) two-edged forearm bands crossing with rounded-square fists: 2 undersized holes and the bands passing 1.5 ink from the opposite fist (gate fail); (2) single-stroke arms with 12x12 ring fists: valid but reads as scissors; (3) 14x16 fists with a finger line on single-stroke arms: valid but reads as paddles, not fists. Reported cannot-fix.
omissions: Not reported done: the fists' knuckle/thumb shape and the forearms' width, which carry the ASL 'love' meaning, cannot be kept with 8-unit spacing at 48px.
drawing_plan: Attempt 3 kept in the module: fists (6..20, 6..22) and (28..42, 6..22) with finger lines at y=14; arms (17,22)-(24,29)-(37,42) and (31,22)-(24,29)-(11,42).
lucide_reference: No Lucide match for crossed fists.
